title: Device Checkout Checklist
subtitle: Capture asset tag, charger, protective case, and software access; confirm existing damage and return condition.
description: Device Checkout records asset tag, charger, protective case, software access, existing damage, and return condition. Device Checkout evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this device checkout stage-gated verification when staff must document asset tag and charger. Reconcile protective case, software access, existing damage, and return condition before the device checkout handoff. Use the inventory record, barcode or serial scan, accessory count, condition images, acceptable-use receipt, repair ticket, return scan, and damage disposition. Ask the assigned device checkout reviewer to confirm asset tag against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Device Checkout starting details
sections.guidance: Match asset tag and serial number to charger and case; photograph existing damage, record software access, custody transfer, repair route, and return condition.

sections.title: Device Checkout checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current device checkout facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Device Checkout required checks
items: Asset tag is identified for this record
Charger matches the current request or source
Protective case is ready for point-of-use staff
Software access limits or questions are resolved
Existing damage is communicated to the responsible person
Return condition is confirmed at handoff
A changed device checkout fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Device Checkout failed or pending items

sections.title: Device Checkout exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold device checkout readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Device Checkout reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Device Checkout receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
